source: Written from memory by the data lead, 2026-09-13. NOT checked against a client, a DB2 dump or Wowhead; see SOURCES.md.
game: World of Warcraft Classic Era (1.15 / patch 1.12 racial set)

shape.races: race id -> { raceName, faction, classes[], traits[] }
shape.trait: name, kind (active|passive), description (short paraphrase of the Classic tooltip, not a verbatim copy), note (optional)

caveats: Descriptions are short paraphrases written from memory, good enough to answer 'is this the same racial?' and not good enough to quote. Anything that turns into a user-visible Classic text must be replaced by a sourced value first.
Numbers are the ones the author remembers; several are approximate (Blood Fury's attack power is level-scaled, Cannibalize heals per tick).
The Classic class lists are the 1.12 ones; Forever's are read from the class bar in data/races/*.json.
